chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Muawiya, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever performs Hajj, let him perform Tamattu'; indeed, we do not compromise with the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and the Sunnah of His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.لْيَتَمَّتَعْ: Let him perform Tamattu (a specific mode of Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Tamattu during Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) mandates the performance of Hajj al-Tamattu', grounding the ruling not merely in juristic preference but in direct adherence to the Quran and the Sunnah of the Prophet (SAW). This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the inseparability of the Prophet's practical tradition from the Quranic text, validating Tamattu' as a divinely sanctioned method of pilgrimage rather than a later legal innovation.
